# RE-EM Tree model

## Aggregated model

### Set up nested blocked CV

```{r}
create_blocked_folds <- function(data, id_col, k) {
  ids <- unique(data[[id_col]])
  folds <- caret::createFolds(ids, k = k, list = TRUE) 
  id_folds <- lapply(folds, function(indices) ids[indices]) 
  lapply(id_folds, function(ids_in_fold) { 
  which(data[[id_col]] %in% as.numeric(ids_in_fold))  
})
}

# Create blocked folds for individuals
set.seed(123)
blocked_folds = create_blocked_folds(treedf_agg, id_col="pid", k = 5)
```



### Positive affect 

```{r}
# Inner loop Function
inner_loop <- function(train_data){

  grid <- expand.grid(
    cp = 0.001,
    minsplit = c(50,100, 200)
  )

  inner_folds <- create_blocked_folds(train_data, id_col="pid", k=5)

  tune_results <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(grid)), function(i){

    params <- grid[i,]

    fold_results <- lapply(seq_along(inner_folds), function(fold){

      valid_idx <- inner_folds[[fold]]
      train_idx <- setdiff(seq_len(nrow(train_data)), valid_idx)

      inner_train <- train_data[train_idx,]
      inner_valid <- train_data[valid_idx,]

      model <- REEMtree(
        DDpa ~ DDanystr + DDanypos + DDanyemospt + DDphyact +
          DDslphour + DDanyphysymp +
          dep + age + race_2g + collegegrad + female + DDwknd,
        random = ~1|pid,
        data = inner_train,
        tree.control = rpart.control(cp=params$cp,
                                     minsplit=params$minsplit),
        correlation = corAR1(form = ~ DDday | pid)
      )

      pred <- predict(model,
                      newdata=inner_valid,
                      EstimateRandomEffects=FALSE)

      actual <- inner_valid$DDpa

      rmse <- sqrt(mean((actual-pred)^2,na.rm=TRUE))
      mae <- mean(abs(actual-pred),na.rm=TRUE)
      ss_total <- sum((actual-mean(actual,na.rm=TRUE))^2,na.rm=TRUE)
      ss_res <- sum((actual-pred)^2,na.rm=TRUE)
      r2 <- 1-ss_res/ss_total

      c(RMSE=rmse,MAE=mae,R2=r2)
    })

    fold_results <- do.call(rbind, fold_results)

    data.frame(
      cp=params$cp,
      minsplit=params$minsplit,
      RMSE=mean(fold_results[,"RMSE"]),
      MAE=mean(fold_results[,"MAE"]),
      R2=mean(fold_results[,"R2"])
    )
  })

  tune_results <- do.call(rbind,tune_results)

  best <- tune_results[which.min(tune_results$RMSE),]

  list(
    best_hyperparameters=best[,c("cp","minsplit")],
    tune_results=tune_results
  )
}
```


```{r}
# Outer loop
set.seed(1234)
results <- lapply(seq_along(blocked_folds), function(outer_fold) { 
  test_indices <- blocked_folds[[outer_fold]]
  train_indices <- setdiff(seq_len(nrow(treedf_agg)), test_indices)
  
  train_data <- treedf_agg[train_indices, ]
  test_data <- treedf_agg[test_indices, ]
  
  inner_results <- inner_loop(train_data)  
  
  best_tune <- inner_results$best_hyperparameters

  final_model = REEMtree(
      DDpa ~ 
        DDanystr + DDanypos + DDanyemospt + DDphyact + DDslphour + DDanyphysymp +
        dep  + age + race_2g + collegegrad + female + DDwknd,
      random = ~ 1 | pid,
      data = train_data,
      tree.control = rpart.control(cp = best_tune$cp, minsplit = best_tune$minsplit),
      correlation = corAR1(form = ~ DDday | pid)
    )
  
  test_predictions <- predict(final_model, newdata = test_data, EstimateRandomEffects = FALSE)
  
  test_actual <- test_data$DDpa
  test_rmse <- sqrt(mean((test_actual - test_predictions)^2, na.rm=TRUE))  # RMSE
  test_mae <- mean(abs(test_actual - test_predictions), na.rm=TRUE)        # MAE
  
  ss_total <- sum((test_actual - mean(test_actual, na.rm=TRUE))^2, na.rm=TRUE)         # Total variance
  ss_residual <- sum((test_actual - test_predictions)^2, na.rm=TRUE)       # Residual variance
  out_of_sample_r2 <- 1 - (ss_residual / ss_total)             
  
  list(
    outer_fold = outer_fold,
    best_hyperparameters = best_tune,
    test_rmse = test_rmse,
    test_mae = test_mae,
    out_of_sample_r2 = out_of_sample_r2
  )
})

# Print results
print(results)

# Combine results
results_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(results, as.data.frame))
print(results_df)
```

full_tuning <- inner_loop(treedf_agg)

print(full_tuning$tune_results)

best_full <- full_tuning$best_hyperparameters

## Item-level models

### Set up nested blocked CV

```{r}
create_blocked_folds <- function(data, id_col, k) {
  ids <- unique(data[[id_col]])
  folds <- caret::createFolds(ids, k = k, list = TRUE) 
  id_folds <- lapply(folds, function(indices) ids[indices]) 
  lapply(id_folds, function(ids_in_fold) { 
  which(data[[id_col]] %in% as.numeric(ids_in_fold))  
})
}

# Create blocked folds for individuals
set.seed(123)
blocked_folds = create_blocked_folds(treedf_item, id_col="pid", k = 5)
```

### positive affect model 

```{r}
# Inner loop Function
inner_loop <- function(train_data){

  grid <- expand.grid(
    cp = 0.001,
    minsplit = c(50,100, 200)
  )

  inner_folds <- create_blocked_folds(train_data, id_col="pid", k=5)

  tune_results <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(grid)), function(i){

    params <- grid[i,]

    fold_results <- lapply(seq_along(inner_folds), function(fold){

      valid_indices <- inner_folds[[fold]]
      train_indices <- setdiff(seq_len(nrow(train_data)), valid_indices)

      inner_train <- train_data[train_indices,]
      inner_valid <- train_data[valid_indices,]

      model <- REEMtree(
        DDpa ~
          DDarg + DDavoidarg + DDworkstr + DDhomestr + DDdiscrim +
          DDnetstr + DDotherstr + DDposint + DDworkpos + DDhomepos +
          DDnetpos + DDotherpos + DDgiveemospt + DDgetemospt +
          DDphyact + DDslphour + DDpain + DDflu + DDgastro +
          DDcirculatory + DDothersymp +
          dep + age + race_2g + collegegrad + female + DDwknd,
        random = ~1|pid,
        data = inner_train,
        tree.control = rpart.control(cp=params$cp, minsplit=params$minsplit),
        correlation = corAR1()
      )

      predictions <- predict(model, newdata=inner_valid, EstimateRandomEffects=FALSE)
      actuals <- inner_valid$DDpa

      rmse <- sqrt(mean((actuals-predictions)^2, na.rm=TRUE))
      mae <- mean(abs(actuals-predictions), na.rm=TRUE)
      ss_total <- sum((actuals-mean(actuals, na.rm=TRUE))^2, na.rm=TRUE)
      ss_residual <- sum((actuals-predictions)^2, na.rm=TRUE)
      r2 <- 1-(ss_residual/ss_total)

      c(RMSE=rmse, MAE=mae, R2=r2)
    })

    fold_results <- do.call(rbind, fold_results)

    data.frame(
      cp=params$cp,
      minsplit=params$minsplit,
      RMSE=mean(fold_results[,"RMSE"], na.rm=TRUE),
      MAE=mean(fold_results[,"MAE"], na.rm=TRUE),
      R2=mean(fold_results[,"R2"], na.rm=TRUE)
    )
  })

  tune_results <- do.call(rbind, tune_results)

  best_hyperparameters_rmse <- tune_results[which.min(tune_results$RMSE), c("cp","minsplit")]
  best_hyperparameters_mae <- tune_results[which.min(tune_results$MAE), c("cp","minsplit")]
  best_hyperparameters_r2 <- tune_results[which.max(tune_results$R2), c("cp","minsplit")]

  list(
    best_hyperparameters_rmse = best_hyperparameters_rmse,
    best_hyperparameters_mae = best_hyperparameters_mae,
    best_hyperparameters_r2 = best_hyperparameters_r2,
    best_hyperparameters = best_hyperparameters_rmse,
    tune_results = tune_results
  )
}
```
